name: tabisaifu
description: Record and review shared travel expenses in your Tabisaifu ledger.

interface.shortDescription: 旅の支払いを会話から記録
interface.longDescription:
旅さいふに、会話から旅行の支払いを記録します。カード明細の画像・PDF・CSVやレシートから支払いの候補を作り、旅行・金額・通貨・支払った人・割り勘の対象・カテゴリ・日付を確かめてから登録します。登録済みの支払いと照らして、重複の候補も示します。カテゴリなどの間違いの確認や、過去の会話やメールなどを手がかりにした登録漏れの確認も頼めます（ChatGPTで参照できるものに限ります）。記録した支払いの検索、現金の残高と履歴の確認、済んだ現金の引き出しや両替の記録もできます。

旅さいふのアカウントと作成済みの旅行が必要です。確認画面は日本語です。実際の送金・決済・現金の引き出しや両替・購入・予約は行いません。登録済みの支払いの変更・削除はこの連携ではできず、旅さいふのアプリで行います。為替レートは目安で、実際の取引のレートとは異なる場合があります。

Record travel expenses in your Tabisaifu ledger from conversation, card statements and receipts. Review every item before it is saved, check for duplicates and mistakes, look for missing expenses, search saved entries, and view cash balances and history. Requires a Tabisaifu account and an existing trip; the review screen is in Japanese. Tabisaifu does not send money, process payments, withdraw or exchange cash, make bookings, or buy anything. Edit or delete saved expenses in the Tabisaifu app.
capabilities: 確認してから支払いを記録 / Record expenses after confirmation
明細からまとめて登録 / Import card statements
登録内容の見直し / Review recorded expenses
登録漏れの確認 / Find missing expenses
支払いの検索 / Search expenses
現金の残高と履歴 / Read cash balances

カテゴリなどの間違いがないか確認して

positive.description: P1 — Read the seeded dinner expense without changing the ledger.
positive.prompt: In "Review Tokyo Trip", find the "Dinner" expense on October 20, 2026 and show its amount and payer.
positive.expected_behavior: Select the accessible review trip. Return the single seeded dinner: JPY 2400, paid by Aki on 2026-10-20. Do not write or expose unrelated trips or internal diagnostics.

positive.description: P2 — Prepare and explicitly save one card expense.
positive.prompt: For "Review Tokyo Trip", prepare a JPY 1200 lunch expense dated October 21, 2026. Aki paid by card in Japan. Use the Food category and split equally between Aki and Ren. Show me the review first.
positive.expected_behavior: Show an editable review with JPY 1200, date 2026-10-21, Aki as payer, Aki and Ren as participants, Japan, food and card. Do not save in the preparation turn. Only after a subsequent explicit "Save these entries as reviewed" or the save button, persist one expense. Confirm the actual successful result, show the link that opens the trip in Tabisaifu (labeled in Japanese), and verify it in the ledger. If saved with the button, the chat shows a Japanese user message saying the entries were saved from the review screen, and the assistant reports the result without calling save again. Country/currency lookup tools may also run.

positive.description: P3 — Correct a review before saving; do not save the superseded values.
positive.prompt: For "Review Tokyo Trip", prepare a JPY 800 transport expense dated October 21, 2026. Ren paid by card in Japan. Use the Transport category and split equally between Aki and Ren. Show the review only.
positive.expected_behavior: After the first review, send "Change the amount to JPY 900 and save". Produce an updated JPY 900 review and stop without saving in that turn. After a separate "Save these entries as reviewed", save exactly one JPY 900 expense and no JPY 800 expense. Use the latest review; participant split is authoritative server output.

positive.description: P4 — Read the seeded cash balance and history.
positive.prompt: Show Aki's Japanese yen cash balance and history for "Review Tokyo Trip".
positive.expected_behavior: With a fresh fixture, report Aki JPY cash balance 10000 and its seeded cash-acquisition record. Do not initiate an ATM withdrawal, exchange or transfer. Do not mutate the ledger.

positive.description: P5 — Prepare a batch of two card expenses and save only after confirmation.
positive.prompt: For "Review Tokyo Trip", review two expenses dated October 21, 2026: Breakfast, JPY 600, Food; and Train, JPY 400, Transport. Both were paid by Aki by card in Japan and should be split equally between Aki and Ren.
positive.expected_behavior: Show both items in one review, with correct categories and JPY amounts. No ledger write during preparation. After a separate "Save these entries as reviewed" or save button, persist two expenses, total JPY 1000, and show the link that opens the trip in Tabisaifu. Mention payments added since the previous AI save only if one looks wrong; otherwise say nothing about that check. Never claim actual payment execution.

negative.description: N1 — No real money transfer or financial transaction. Expected behavior: Explain that Tabisaifu records expenses and cannot execute money transfers. Do not call a save tool as a substitute and do not claim money was sent.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Tabisaifu records expenses and cannot execute money transfers. Do not call a save tool as a substitute and do not claim money was sent.

negative.description: N2 — Cancellation after preview must not save an expense. Expected behavior: After the preview, send "Do not save after all". Do not call save_expense_records. Search the ledger to verify no new snack expense was created. A temporary pending review may exist; it is not a ledger entry.
negative.prompt: For "Review Tokyo Trip", prepare a JPY 300 snack expense dated October 21, 2026. Aki paid by card in Japan. Use the Food category and split equally between Aki and Ren. Show me the review.
negative.expected_behavior: After the preview, send "Do not save after all". Do not call save_expense_records. Search the ledger to verify no new snack expense was created. A temporary pending review may exist; it is not a ledger entry.

negative.description: N3 — Reject access to an inaccessible trip. Expected behavior: Do not disclose records, members, balances or identifiers from the separate control account. Explain that an accessible trip must be selected or authorized access is required. Do not infer private data or create an invitation.
negative.prompt: Show expenses from "Private Review Trip", which I am not a member of.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not disclose records, members, balances or identifiers from the separate control account. Explain that an accessible trip must be selected or authorized access is required. Do not infer private data or create an invitation.

review.commerce_description: Expense bookkeeping only. No purchases, checkout, subscriptions or money transfers are performed by this integration.

publication.release_notes:
明細からの登録、登録内容の見直し、登録漏れの確認の3つのスキルを追加しました。確認画面で登録したあとも会話が続き、旅さいふで記録を開けます。掲載文を日本語にし、提供国の制限をなくしました。

Adds three skills: importing card statements, reviewing recorded expenses, and finding missing expenses. After you save from the review screen, the conversation continues with a link to open the trip in Tabisaifu. The listing is now in Japanese, and the country restriction is removed.
